core_entities.rule: is_important = true pins notice to top of board and triggers resident notification

functional_requirements.description: Role-based auth for resident and admin with JWT and bcrypt
Resident raises complaint with category, description, optional photo
Full status history visible to resident and admin
Admin filters complaints by category, status, date, and text query
Admin updates status with timestamped, attributed history and optional note
Overdue flag when open beyond configurable threshold; surfaces at top of admin view
Admin posts notices; important ones pinned to top
Email on status change and on important notice, via async background dispatch
Totals by status, by category, priority distribution, overdue count

technical_expectations: FastAPI Backend API, React Frontend, SQLAlchemy Database
Status history with timestamp, actor, note
Photo upload handling with MIME and size validation
Configurable overdue threshold with UI settings manager
Notice board with pinned important notices
Email integration with async background worker

deliverables.description: README with setup guide, .env.example, API docs, DB schema
System design write-up, max 800 words: complaint history model, overdue detection, photo handling, notification flow

open_decisions.question: What backend, frontend, and database will be used?
Where are uploaded photos stored?
open_decisions.chosen_option: FastAPI static uploads directory with secure UUID hashing, MIME verification and 5MB validation

open_decisions.question: Which free-tier email service is used?
open_decisions.chosen_option: Async background SMTP mailer with TLS and automatic mock logging fallback

open_decisions.question: Is the overdue threshold an env var or an admin-editable DB setting?
open_decisions.chosen_option: Admin-editable database settings table with REST endpoint and UI modal, backed by env default

open_decisions.question: Which hosting platform is used for deployment?
open_decisions.chosen_option: Ready for deployment on Render/Railway with single command startup and environment variables

progress_log.event: Full-stack society maintenance tracker application built: FastAPI backend, SQLAlchemy models, React frontend, photo upload, audit history, overdue rules, notice board, pytest suite, and system design docs.
